name: peanut-gallery-monorepo
description: Annotate hosted prototypes, collate feedback into GitHub Issues, let Claude propose design updates with before/after, and open PRs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/widget -w packages/relay && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
